summary: Defines an ENUM NAPTR record type for Internet fax (IFax) service. DNS returns the email address of the target IFax system, so a sender can use a telephone number to reach it instead of needing to know the address in advance. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: You know your friend's phone number but not their mailbox. This memo lets a directory turn the phone number into the right email address so your fax finds them.

questions: send fax using phone number via dns
